purpose: Bounded external native-pixel GT-center engineering stress test; not clinical validation, detection, WSI scoring, or a representative full BCData benchmark.
selection_rule: First 10 full archive paths in Python lexicographic order among official BCData/images/test/*.png; all provided positive and negative coordinates; no image replacement.
selection_knowledge: Only test/0.png pixels, metadata and coordinates inspected before locking; no model inference on BCData before this lock.
features: Unchanged local 40 RGB/HSV/optical-density features with integer-radius disks 3 and 7 in native pixels; centers Nx2 interpreted as x,y.
preprocessing: Native 640x640 uint8 RGB; no resizing, stain normalization, calibration, label-dependent transforms, fine-tuning, refitting, threshold selection, or parameter search.
class_decision: Unchanged four-class softmax argmax. Predictions of either non-tumor class are errors for these tumor-only reference points, never remapped to correct staining status.
metrics: Unchanged four-class confusion matrix, accuracy and per-class precision/recall/F1, with absent-class support exposed. Four-class macro-F1 uses the original zero_division=0 convention and is not comparable to a complete four-class test.
Tumor-positive/negative reference-class mean F1 (supplementary); retain all predictions including non-tumor errors.
Per-image GT ratio positive/(positive+negative); predicted ratio predicted_class0/(predicted_class0+predicted_class1); undefined when denominator=0; report every image and all undefined counts.
Unweighted mean per-image absolute error in percentage points over defined images; all exclusions explicit.
Independent confusion/count/ratio arithmetic from saved predictions must reproduce project metrics.
validation_rules: All coordinates numeric finite integer Nx2 and within image; duplicate or cross-class conflicting centers cause stop and explicit report, never silent deletion.
Archive CRC32 and byte sizes checked for each selected entry; SHA256 for images/labels/protocol/model/code recorded.
Check exact selected-image byte/pixel duplicates and exact whole-image hashes against prior Patherea source manifest; do not claim patient-level independence or absence of subimage overlap.
No patient/slide linkage exists in archive; first ten filenames are convenience sample, cannot estimate patient-level performance or confidence intervals.

physical_scale.magnification_reported: 40x in primary comparative Patherea paper Table 1; microscope with camera in section 2.2
physical_scale.handling: No physical-scale matching asserted; maintain original pixels and explicitly qualify results as native-pixel domain shift.
